headline: Norway Mainland GDP Grows 0.1 Percent in Third Quarter
summary: Norway's mainland GDP grew 0.1 percent in the third quarter of 2026 at constant prices, supported by high oil and gas prices contributing to a strong trade balance surplus.
why: Quarterly GDP growth figures are critical indicators for the central bank's monetary policy path and overall economic health in resource-dependent advanced economies.

impacts.name: Norwegian Krone
impacts.why: Positive GDP growth and high trade surpluses support the domestic currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger-than-expected economic output and trade surpluses boost confidence in the domestic economy and currency.
